hypothesis: Add structlog foundation and instrument core simulation modules (loop.py, board.py, agents.py) for structured logging
ceo_rationale: Score improved but failed to cross 0.6 threshold. Precheck gate auto-reverted due to threshold miss. Observability gained 42pp but insufficient breadth for composite lift.
learned: Single-dimension improvements must be paired with complementary fixes (tests, lint, type) to achieve composite threshold crossing.
anti_patterns: Optimizing one dimension without addressing bottlenecks in others
Assuming large improvements in observability will alone cross composite threshold

playbook_proposals.content: When optimizing observability, pair with lint/type fixes in same experiment for bundled threshold crossing
For composite-scored projects, multi-dimension bundling is required; single-dimension experiments rarely exceed threshold
